title: Holomorphic Approximation for Real Diffeomorphism Groups
summary: We show that every diffeomorphism of $\mathbb{R}^n$ for $n \ge 2$ can be approximated by an automorphism of $\mathbb{C}^n$ in the Whitney $C^k$-topology for any positive integer $k$ using the notion of density property. More precisely we find sufficient conditions for this holomorphic approximation of diffeomorphisms to hold and prove that the split real forms of most linear algebraic groups satisfy these conditions.
